verseText: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
meaning: God created human beings in his likeness. That makes us special. We are more like God than any of the other creatures he made.

recall.question: Who was made in God's image?

meaning.question: Being made in God's image means we're made to reflect what He is like. What does this teach us about people?

application.prompt: There are so many different types of people in the work. But every person you'll ever meet is made in God's image. How should that change how you should treat them?
